title: YOLOv8 INT8 Edge Quantization & IRC:106 PCU Standardization
objective: Implement edge vision object detection running at 80+ FPS using INT8 quantization and convert raw counts to physical road occupancy using IRC:106 Passenger Car Units.
acceptance_criteria: Quantize YOLOv8 neural network to INT8 precision with sub-15ms edge inference.
Map detections: Car=1.0, Bus/Truck=3.0, Motorcycle=0.5, Bicycle=0.2, Pedestrian=0.1.
Trigger immediate preemption bypass when Class-1 emergency vehicle detected.
Verify zero accuracy degradation compared to FP32 baseline.

title: Webster Delay-Minimizing Adaptive Signal Timing Engine
objective: Implement Highway Capacity Manual (HCM) Webster signal optimization computing dynamic critical flow ratios, lost time L=18.0s, optimal cycle C0, and proportional green splits.
acceptance_criteria: Compute critical flow ratios y_i = q_i / S_i and clamp sum Y between [0.10, 0.85].
Calculate Webster optimal cycle C_0 = (1.5*L + 5) / (1 - Y).
Enforce safety bounds: minimum green >= 10s, maximum green <= 60s, yellow clearance = 3.0s.
Demonstrate delay reduction of >= 45% vs fixed-time signalization.

title: Connected Vehicle V2X SAE J2735 SPaT & MAP Telemetry
objective: Broadcast real-time Signal Phase & Timing (SPaT Message 19) and Intersection Geometry (MAP Message 18) for Connected & Automated Vehicles (CAVs) and GLOSA.
acceptance_criteria: Encode SPaT Message 19 with sub-second countdown clocks and phase states.
Encode MAP Message 18 with 3D lane geometries and stop bar coordinates in WGS-84.
Broadcast SPaT telemetry over WebSocket and REST endpoints at 10 Hz.
Comply with ISO 19091 and SAE J2735 standards.

title: Planar Homography Inverse Perspective Mapping (BEV Radar)
objective: Transform perspective 2D camera coordinates into a metric ground plane bird's-eye view (BEV) using calibrated 3x3 planar homography transformation matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Calibrate 4-point ground homography matrix H for intersection lanes.
Calculate true distance-to-stopline in meters independent of perspective foreshortening.
Integrate with ByteTrack kinematics to calculate true vehicle speeds in km/h.
Verify metric spatial accuracy within +/- 0.5 meters.
